project_context.name: Manasati (منصتي)
project_context.description: Arabic-first, fully RTL SaaS website builder targeting Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.
project_context.goal: Outclass competitor mnasati.com with a dramatically better, premium, 'Godly' aesthetic. Move away from generic AI-slop to a distinct, high-contrast, premium SaaS identity.
project_context.stack: React 19, React Router 7, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, framer-motion, lucide-react (.js files only)

global_design_system.aesthetic: Oasis & Obsidian - A highly premium, trustworthy, and effortless look. Deep obsidian dark modes for the pro-builder, crisp bone-white for marketing, punctuated by high-contrast layout tensions.

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule applies. Overhaul the Arabic typography scale.
typography.primary_heading_font: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Cairo, or Almarai. MUST use font-black (900) or font-extrabold (800) for H1/H2.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing + The Bento Grid Protocol (Tetris for Marketing, High Density for Builder).
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-20
spacing_and_layout.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Mix spans (col-span-8, col-span-4) for aggressive asymmetry.

surface_styles.marketing_cards: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60) with 1px border-white/20.
surface_styles.builder_dashboard: Neumorphism/Solid surfaces with 1px border-border, shadow-sm, flat background.

rtl_arabic_guidelines.critical_mandate: NEVER use physical direction utility classes (ml, mr, pl, pr, left, right). MUST use logical properties.

logical_classes.flex_grid: flex-row defaults to RTL in dir='rtl'. Do not use flex-row-reverse unless specifically flipping layout.

rtl_arabic_guidelines.icons: Icons implying direction (arrows, chevrons) MUST be wrapped in a class or mapped to flip in RTL (e.g., `rtl:rotate-180`).
rtl_arabic_guidelines.text_alignment: Avoid center alignment for paragraphs. Default to text-start.

marketing_site_blueprint.header: Fixed, Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70). NEVER fully transparent. Include Brand, Nav Links, and CTA 'ابدأ مجانا' (Start for free).
marketing_site_blueprint.hero_section: Text on start (right in RTL), dynamic visual on end (left in RTL). Headline: Benefit-led. CTA: High contrast pill button. Visual: Abstract 3D shape or highly polished builder UI floating over a subtle gradient orb.
marketing_site_blueprint.features_bento: Asymmetrical grid showcasing builder features (AI generation, RTL perfection, Store). Heavy use of lucide-react icons with subtle glowing backgrounds.
marketing_site_blueprint.template_showcase: Horizontal swiper or masonry grid. Hovering over a template card reveals a 'Live Preview' button with framer-motion scale-up effect.
marketing_site_blueprint.pricing_preview: Monthly/Yearly toggle. 3 plans. Middle plan scaled up (scale-105) with 'The Tracing Beam' border effect (animated gradient border).
marketing_site_blueprint.integrations_strip: Grayscale logos (Moyasar, ResellerClub, etc.) moving in an infinite Marquee using purely CSS or framer-motion.
marketing_site_blueprint.footer: Massive typography for final CTA ('أطلق منصتك الآن'). Dark footer contrasting with a light body.

template_builder_renderer.architecture_rule: Templates MUST NOT have hardcoded colors. They must rely exclusively on CSS variables scoped to their wrapper.
template_builder_renderer.theme_injection: Wrap the rendered template in `<div className='template-theme-wrapper' style={{ '--primary': template.colors.primary, '--background': template.colors.bg }}>`.
template_builder_renderer.live_preview_experience: Instead of a static thumbnail, the 'Preview' route must render the actual section components inside a scaled container (e.g., `transform: scale(0.75); transform-origin: top center;`) to look exactly like the real site.

section_components.services: Grid of cards. Cards use `--card` background.
section_components.store: Products grid. Cart and checkout use Shadcn components customized with template variables.

ui_components_customization.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp rounded-lg. Add transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-95.
ui_components_customization.cards: Remove default Shadcn heavy shadows. Use flat borders `border border-border/40` and hover lift.
ui_components_customization.dialogs: Backdrop blur on the overlay (`backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/40`). Content must be strictly RTL aligned.
ui_components_customization.inputs: Focus state must be highly visible: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2`.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Micro-interactions on every clickable element. Static = dead.

framer_motion_defaults.entrance: { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.5, ease: [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] } }
framer_motion_defaults.stagger: Use variants to stagger lists (e.g., pricing features, template cards).

testing_requirements.data_testid: All interactive elements, forms, and key informational nodes MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not interact with the user, proceed directly with implementation.
Ensure `dir='rtl'` is set on the root HTML/layout and rely strictly on Tailwind logical properties (`ms-`, `pe-`, `border-s-`).
Do not center-align everything. Use asymmetric bento grids to build tension.
Implement the 'Oasis & Obsidian' color variables in index.css.
For the Template Renderer, do NOT hardcode colors in the section components. Use Shadcn's semantic CSS variables so the builder can inject custom hex codes dynamically.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds on headers or dialogs. Always use solid or glassmorphism.
Build the dashboard focusing on density and data correlation, using crisp borders and minimal shadows.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. DO NOT center align the app container. Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
